content:
Anya K.: quick summary — brought up 70B-q4f16 on H100 vs A100 across us-east / eu-west. posting numbers and asking ops how to size a Dedicated pool for a single-tenant customer that needs 99th <= 350ms and sustained 1500 rps at peak (avg tokens/request ~ 60)
Sam C.: nice. can you paste the raw bench output? curious batch sizes and concurrency used for each run
Anya K.: pasted below (all runs batch=1, seq_len=512, sampling topk=1 for deterministic latency)
```
# H100 (us-east)
p50: 48ms, p95: 120ms, p99: 280ms, throughput: 180 tps (tokens/sec), conv: ~90 req/s
# A100 (eu-west)
p50: 62ms, p95: 155ms, p99: 360ms, throughput: 140 tps, conv: ~70 req/s
# H100 (eu-west)
p50: 52ms, p95: 130ms, p99: 300ms, throughput: 170 tps, conv: ~85 req/s
```
Anya K.: throughput here is tokens/sec per GPU. to map to requests/s: requests/s = throughput / avg_tokens_per_req -> e.g. 180/60 = 3 rps per GPU? wait that seems low — but bench was steady-state single-sequence batching. we ran a concurrency sweep separately and see about 60-90 concurrent in-flight sequences depending on gpu
Leo N.: that matches my local: H100 can handle higher concurrency because of kernel tiling + fp16 perf. A100 suffers more at high seq_len because of memory tiling. For slotting math, treat H100 nominal request concurrency per GPU = 80, A100 = 60 for 70B-q4f16 (seq median 256).
Sasha P.: ops ask: customer requires p99 <= 350ms. from the bench only A100 in eu-west hits p99 360ms (slightly over). safe sizing should include headroom for bursts and regional tail. propose: target per-GPU cap = 0.7 * observed concurrency where p99 < 350ms. so H100 cap=56, A100 cap=42.
Sam C.: can we convert that to pool size? customer peak 1500 rps -> with avg_tokens 60 => peak token rate 90k tps. using per-GPU throughput (tokens/sec): H100 180 tps -> GPUs needed = ceil(90000/180) = 500 GPUs. with cap factor from Sasha (per-GPU effective rps) that seems off. let's instead do requests/s math: if H100 handles ~80 concurrent sequences and avg request duration ~200ms p50, sustained rps per GPU ~ (80 / 0.2s) = 400 rps? that doesn't line up with earlier throughput calc — we need consistent numbers.
Anya K.: sorry for mixing metrics. here's the canonical numbers from concurrency sweep (seq_len=512, avg_tokens=60):
```
H100: max_concurrency_before_p99>350ms = 60 concurrent seqs -> sustained ~300 rps (avg latency 200ms)
A100: max_concurrency_before_p99>350ms = 45 concurrent seqs -> sustained ~225 rps
```
Anya K.: so using those: required GPUs = ceil(1500 / 300) = 5 H100 GPUs (ideal), or ceil(1500 / 225) = 7 A100 GPUs. add autoscale headroom and AZ redundancy -> +40% baseline -> H100: 7 GPUs, A100: 10 GPUs per region
ops-oncall: 7 GPUs for H100 sounds fine but we need warmup slots and cold-start buffer. for Dedicated we recommend reserve + burst: reserve 6, allow burst to 10 within minutes.
Sasha P.: agree. also recommend per-pool kernel pinning: enable tiling kernels + fused attention on H100; on A100 prefer fallback tiling parameters we tested. set quant profile to `q4f16` pinned; fallback to `q8a` only if memory pressure.
Leo N.: I'd add a safety factor for night surge (historical spikes up to 1.6x). so if customer cares about night-99, plan reserve 8 H100 GPUs (burst 12).
infra-bot: bench artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/bench/1765432100/70b-q4f16-grid.csv (contains raw logs + concurrency sweep) :white_check_mark:
Sam C.: action items: (1) Anya to convert bench CSV -> slotting input (2) Sasha to draft Dedicated pool config (reserve/burst/regions) (3) Ops to add warmup slots + autoscale policy (cooldown 120s).
Anya K.: filing a runbook snippet here for slotting calc: 
```
# slotting calc
required_rps = peak_rps
per_gpu_rps = max_concurrency_before_p99 / avg_latency_seconds
gpus_needed = ceil(required_rps / per_gpu_rps)
# apply buffers: gpus_needed *= 1.4 (headroom) ; nightsurge *= 1.6 if enabled
```
ops-oncall: will add the policy: reserve = max(ceil(gpus_needed * 0.85), min_reserve=2) ; burst = ceil(gpus_needed * 1.6) ; cooldown=120s
Sasha P.: note for rollouts: start canary on 1 GPU in region for 24h, monitor p99 and error-rate, then scale to reserve. don't enable cross-region failover until we've verified EU p99 under 5% of baseline.
Leo N.: kernel note to infra: enable the H100 tiling experiment in dedicated runtime for this pool and mark metric `kernel.tiling.enabled=true` for auditing.
Anya K.: thanks all — I'll upload the converted slotting JSON and link to the ticket (#ENG-1289) when done. :thumbsup:
